// D Flip-Flop module
module origen_004706 (
    input d, rst, clk,
    output reg q,
    output qb
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst)
            q <= 1'b0;
        else
            q <= d;
    end

    assign qb = ~q;

endmodule

// Testbench
module dff_tb;
    reg D, rst1, CLK;
    wire Q, QB;

    // Instantiate the DFF
    dff dut (
        .d(D),
        .rst(rst1),
        .clk(CLK),
        .q(Q),
        .qb(QB)
    );

    // Clock generation
    initial begin
        CLK = 0;
        forever #10 CLK = ~CLK;
    end

    // Stimulus
    initial begin
        D = 0; rst1 = 1;
        #20 rst1 = 0;
        #10 D = 1;
        #20 rst1 = 1;
        #10 D = 0;
        #20 rst1 = 0;
        #10 D = 1;
        #10 $finish;
    end

    // Monitor
    initial begin
        $monitor("Time=%0t D=%b rst1=%b CLK=%b Q=%b QB=%b", $time, D, rst1, CLK, Q, QB);
        $dumpfile("dff_tb.vcd");
        $dumpvars(0, dff_tb);
    end

endmodule
